verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs say it supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET and Java with equal capability. Its GitHub README promotes standard language features such as loops, functions, classes and package management. Community users independently praise managing infrastructure with TypeScript's type system and note that typing has improved over time; some complain about Apply/dependency complexity, but that does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: explicit first-party or hands-on evidence of IDE support (autocomplete, inline type checking) — it is only implied by the typed languages.
